dct_description_sm: "Entered according to an act of Congress, in the year 1858, by Jones, Root & Co. in the Clerks Office of the District Court of the Eastern District Office of Texas."

"General Land Office, Austin, November 18th 1857." Relief shown by hachures. Shows longitude West from Greenwich and Washington. "Entered according to an act of Congress, in the year 1858, by Jones, Root & Co. in the Clerks Office of the District Court of the Eastern District Office of Texas." Includes table of contents, notes, and ill. Insets: Map of the old colony -- Map of original land districts. Mounted on linen. Copy imperfect: Torn in margins with holes and water stains throughout. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
